question_record.context: A security incident involved the user Luciano Herrera and the addition of credentials to an OAuth application named SimulandApp. This suspicious activity may indicate a potential compromise. Additionally, an unknown tool or technique was used to gather information about a device, suggesting the attackers might be trying to gather information about the target device or network for later attacks.
question_record.question: What is the email associated with the user who added credentials to the OAuth application SimulandApp?
solution: The user Luciano Herrera (AadUserId: `2de70991-2799-4a95-b734-8e3df3a50118`) performed an unusual addition of credentials (type Password) to the application SimulandApp.
There was a suspicious system hardware discovery on the host `mb-winclient`.
A malicious URL `https://ym018491661.wittytree-b6f239d6.northeurope.azurecontainerapps.io/` was clicked on the device.

80.name: Unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app
80.description: The user Luciano Herrera (pwilson@niseko.alpineskihouse.co) performed an unusual addition of credentials to the application SimulandApp. This usage pattern may indicate that an attacker has compromised the app, and is using it to spread phishing, exfiltrate data, or to gain access to other accounts and devices. The user added a credential of type Password. A credential of type Password is added when an application is using a password to authenticate.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_Derived_Email' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
